newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P rates RMT A$240 mln securitised bonds.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates RMT A$240 mln securitised bonds.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it assigned an AAA rating to RMT Securitisation Trust No 2's A$228 million of class A senior bonds.
S&P said it had also assigned a rating of AA-minus to RMT's A$12 million of class B subordinated bonds.
The bonds are backed by a pool of assets of residential property mortgages originated by FAI First Mortgage Pty Limited.

The AAA rating of the senior bonds reflected the credit quality of the assets of the trust and the mortgage insurance, and other chracteristics of the structure, which together enabled RMT to meet interest obligations in a timely manner and repay principal to bond holders by the final maturity date, S&P said.
